audience: A lender reviewing a funding request
executive_summary: Northwind Studio sells a shared job board so independent design studios can track briefs, files, and approvals in one place. The target customer is studios with 2 to 10 people. No funding amount or market-size figure was provided.
business_concept: A shared job board for briefs, files, and approvals so small studios can stop tracking client work in email and spreadsheets.
mission: Give small studios one place to run client work.

values.text: Only ship features a studio asked for.

objectives.text: Serve the studios the founder already works with.

products_and_services: A monthly subscription for the studio, billed per workspace. One job board covers briefs, files, and approvals.
sourcing: The founder builds and hosts the product. No outside manufacturer was named.
market_analysis: The only demand evidence provided is studios in the founder's existing network. No market-size figure was provided.
target_customer: Independent design studios with 2 to 10 people.
marketing_plan: Direct outreach to studios the founder already works with.

assumptions.text: The first ten studios come from the founder's existing network.

review_cadence: Quarterly while the studio is still finding its first customers.
